Enrich person.title: VP Mortgage Servicing Operations Manager
Enrich person.summary: I am a service professional offering 20 plus years of supervisory, customer service and training experience.   Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Dedicated to achieving customer satisfaction as well as meeting or surpassing company expectations. Able to focus on projects, develop and implement training strategies and meet deadlines. Experienced with off shore teams as well as multiple onshore locations.  Strong rapport with personnel, clients and associates based on knowledge, professionalism, and integrity.
Enrich person.headline: VP Mortgage Servicing Operations Manager at Truist

experience.title: Teller Connect Team Manager
experience.summary:
Currently working with a staff of 23 to Pilot the Teller Connect program for Orlando CCC while exceeding company standards of all metrics.
•	Research and correct errors.
•	Facilitated training of all TCR’s in creation of RETS cases in Atlanta and Orlando.
•	Updated multiple SOS procedures.
•	Partnered with Technical Teams, STU trainers and project managers to ensure successful launch of the site.
•	Speak to Executive groups about the Teller Connect program during facility visits.
•	Maintain a clean and positive work environment while ensuring that technology requirements meet client expectations.
•	Remain a contact for Offshore Fraud trainers.
•	Excellent teammate retention rate.
•	100% Manager VOT and 99.3% workgroup VOT in 2016

experience.title: CCC/CFS-Problem Resolution Team Manager
experience.summary:
Maintaining company expectations while managing a staff of 50 – 19 teammates handling incoming supervisor calls for 7 Lines of Business while exceeding all process monitoring goals.
•	Co-facilitated training for Fraud Prevention and Claims Offshore/Philippines.
•	United Way captain 2014.
•	1st quarter Top Team Manager.
•	Overall 4.2 VOT and 4.72 Manager VOT.
•	Diversity Council Member.
•	Assisted in identifying and closing training gaps.
•	Resource for all teammates in many areas of the bank.
•	Facilitated cross training for care teammates in Orlando and Cookeville.
•	Facilitated Regulation E Tracking System (RETS) Credit Card training in Cookeville and Orlando.
•	Active in all Site and Department activities.

experience.title: Channel Operations/STOLI Fraud Prevention and Claims Team Manager
experience.summary:
Accomplishing department objectives by leading a staff of 25 teammates to handle incoming call volume, maintain policies and procedures as well as encourage optimum performance.
•	Co-facilitated card security portion of new hire/temporary trainees.
•	United Way precinct captain – exceeding goal of 2013.
•	Top Team in November 2013.
•	Team maintains the lowest AHT in the department for 6 months running.
•	Overall 4.2 VOT and 4.72 Manager VOT.
•	Diversity Council Member.
•	Assist teammates and clients by taking escalated calls.
•	Effectively process payroll.
•	Responsible for processing new hires as well as exiting teammates via online forms.
•	Maintain a positive and effective environment for all teammates to deliver a stellar client experience.
•	Uncover procedural gaps and work to build effective processes.
•	Active in all department activities and goals.
•	Site Manager Committee Member.
